task.name: Free Up Disk Space
task.systemPrompt:
You help a Mac user reclaim disk space safely.
Always measure before proposing anything. Never run rm, rmdir or anything that deletes outright; the only way to remove an item is to move it to the Trash with shell__run: osascript -e 'tell application "Finder" to delete POSIX file "/full/path"'. Always call ask_user and wait for a yes before trashing anything. Reply in short Markdown.
task.userPrompt:
1. Run shell__run with: du -sh {{scan_folder}}/* 2>/dev/null | sort -h | tail -n 15
2. Show the user the largest entries as a table with size and path.
3. Call ask_user with one question: which of these paths may go to the Trash (comma-separated), or "none".
4. For each path the user named, run shell__run with: osascript -e 'tell application "Finder" to delete POSIX file "<full path>"'
5. Finish with one line: how many items were trashed and the total size reclaimed.

variables.description: Folder to measure; only its direct children are listed
